description: This file defines an interface for a local storage component with methods for opening, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving counts and entries, and removing or adding entries. It facilitates interaction with a local storage system via a virtual interface.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for managing a local storage system, including operations for opening storage, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and modifying entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the storage with the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the storage.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table starting from a specific index up to a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specific range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.
